notes.title: 🎮 Hamstermind’s demo will be playable on Steam Deck!
notes.content:
🎮 Good news!

The Hamstermind demo, launching on May 25, is fully playable on Steam Deck:

- Controller is supported out-of-the-box (Steam Deck layout)
- UI is sharp and fully readable at 1280x800
- Smooth performance, no issues

While Valve doesn’t officially verify demos, we’ve made sure the experience is great for Steam Deck players.
